summary: SR-3 (2026-10-02, OWNER-SR3-NEAR-01): SR-2's cost-weighted margin error restricted to the published important region (311 of 1,588 scoring cases), pre-registered and tested in 286 profiles offline on EV2's verified predictions. Outcome NO_PROMOTION. n sharpens the safety signal (the boundary optimist overstates near-limit margins by 2.41 bands, real MLPs 0.58-0.97) but tracks decisions worse (verification tau 0.177 against g's 0.309). Across SR-1 to SR-3, EV2's development and verification conditions disagree about which rule is best, so with 14 members selection does not transfer: the limit is the evidence, not the formula. Three consecutive non-progressing studies fire the STUCK trigger (TRACK-B-STUCK-01): full Track B review by the SciML lead and the owner. The recommendation is to rerun SR-1 to SR-3 on EV4's 99 members after regenerating and verifying their predictions (about USD 1-3), then confirm once in EV5. No testnet rule changed.
